Container.Name: acme-helper
Container.Overview:
Unofficial ACME DNS-01 automation for FortiWeb. Obtains (wildcard) certificates from Let's Encrypt via certbot, sets the DNS challenge records at Cloudflare, do.de or Strato (also via CNAME delegation), uploads the certificate to FortiWeb through its REST API, binds it to server policies / SNI members and cleans up old versions. Runs as a daemon and checks daily; certbot renews 30 days before expiry.
This is an independent community project and NOT an official Fortinet tool. Not affiliated with Fortinet, Strato, Domain-Offensive, Cloudflare or Let's Encrypt.
Configuration is done entirely via the variables below (no config file needed). Secrets are only passed as environment variables. Test first with ACME_STAGING=true. Run "acme-helper check --probe" from the container console to verify DNS providers and the FortiWeb connection.

Config.Name: Data (certbot state, deployed.json)
Config.Description: Persistent data: Let's Encrypt account, certificates, deployment state. Back this up.

Config.Name: Config (optional config.yaml)
Config.Description: Optional. If a config.yaml exists here it takes precedence over the variables below. Also the place for a FortiWeb CA bundle (FW_VERIFY_TLS=/config/ca.pem).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID owning /data (Unraid default nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID owning /data (Unraid default users = 100).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the daily schedule.

Config.Name: Schedule time (HH:MM)
Config.Description: Daily run time in the TZ above. A run at container start happens as well.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: INFO or DEBUG (DEBUG shows certbot calls and HTTP details).

Config.Name: ACME e-mail
Config.Description: Contact e-mail for the Let's Encrypt account (expiry warnings). Required; enables the env-only configuration mode.

Config.Name: ACME staging
Config.Description: true = Let's Encrypt staging (untrusted test certificates, no rate limits). Set to false once everything works, then force a renewal from the console: acme-helper run --once --force-renew

Config.Name: ACME key type
Config.Description: ecdsa or rsa

Config.Name: ACME propagation timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait until the TXT records are visible on all authoritative name servers.

Config.Name: ACME directory URL
Config.Description: Optional: other ACME CA instead of Let's Encrypt.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: API token with Zone:DNS:Edit and Zone:Zone:Read for the affected zones. Leave empty if Cloudflare is not used.

Config.Name: do.de Let's Encrypt token
Config.Description: Domain-Offensive (do.de) Let's Encrypt API token from my.do.de. Leave empty if not used.

Config.Name: Strato user
Config.Description: Strato customer number / login. Only needed for Strato domains WITHOUT CNAME delegation. Leave empty if not used.

Config.Name: Strato password
Config.Description: Strato login password.

Config.Name: Strato TOTP secret
Config.Description: Base32 TOTP secret if 2FA is enabled on the Strato account. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Strato TOTP device name
Config.Description: Name of the TOTP device as shown in the Strato login (needed with 2FA).

Config.Name: Zones
Config.Description: Which DNS provider manages which zone, matched against the name AFTER CNAME resolution (longest suffix wins). Format: suffix=provider, separated by ; or , . Providers: cf, dode, strato. Example: example.com=cf;acme.example.net=dode;legacy-strato.de=strato . Can be left empty if exactly one provider is configured.

Config.Name: FortiWeb host
Config.Description: IP or hostname of the FortiWeb management interface. Leave empty to only obtain certificates without deploying.

Config.Name: FortiWeb port
Config.Description: HTTPS admin port.

Config.Name: FortiWeb user
Config.Description: Admin account with REST API access (trusted host must include the Unraid IP).

Config.Name: FortiWeb password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account.

Config.Name: FortiWeb VDOM
Config.Description: Virtual domain, usually root.

Config.Name: FortiWeb verify TLS
Config.Description: true, false, or a path to a CA bundle inside /config (e.g. /config/fortiweb-ca.pem).

Config.Name: FortiWeb import method
Config.Description: multipart (documented) or json (certificate.local.json_cert).

Config.Name: FortiWeb body wrapper
Config.Description: data = send {"data": {...}} on cmdb PUT/POST, none = raw object. Change only if the firmware rejects updates.

Config.Name: Cert 1: domains
Config.Description: Comma separated. Example: example.com,*.example.com

Config.Name: Cert 1: FortiWeb name prefix
Config.Description: Certificate is stored on FortiWeb as <prefix>-<YYYYMMDD>. Default: derived from the first domain (wc-example-com).

Config.Name: Cert 1: server policies
Config.Description: Comma separated FortiWeb server policy names whose 'certificate' field is set to the new certificate.

Config.Name: Cert 1: SNI bindings
Config.Description: Optional. Format: group:pattern|pattern;group2 . Members of the SNI group whose domain matches get the new certificate; no pattern = all members. Example: sni-main:*.example.com|example.com

Config.Name: Cert 1: chain mode
Config.Description: intermediate-group (upload intermediates into an Intermediate CA group and bind it), fullchain (upload fullchain.pem as the certificate) or none.

Config.Name: Cert 1: keep old versions
Config.Description: How many previous certificate versions to keep on FortiWeb.

Config.Name: Cert 2: domains
Config.Description: Optional second certificate. Same format as Cert 1. For more certificates add CERT3_*, CERT4_* ... variables.

Config.Name: Notification webhook
Config.Description: Optional URL that receives a JSON POST (fields: status, message, text, details) on success and failure. Works with Slack/Teams incoming webhooks, ntfy, Discord-compatible relays or custom endpoints.
